Name: Strathwood Whidbey Cast-Aluminum Coffee Table

Rectangular-shaped coffee table designed for outdoor use Made of durable, lightweight, rust-resistant cast aluminum in dark, flecked finish Elegant multi-step hand finish; scrolling lattice motif design on top Some assembly required; coordinates with Whidbey collection Measures 40 inches long by 20 inches wide by 17.7 inches high Rust Free Cast Aluminum Frame Elegant Multi-Step Hand Finish Sturdy Construction
